blocks.text: A CPA in Tampa Talks About What Taxes Must Be Paid By a Florida Business

Florida traditionally is considered a tax-friendly environment, whether pertaining to businesses or individuals. The fact that there is no individual state income tax has helped attract new residents for years. Yet, as tax-friendly as Florida is, company owners still have many taxes to be aware of as they conduct business in the Sunshine State.

A [CPA in Tampa](http://www.reliancecpa.com/) from Reliance Consulting, LLC, can help a business owner sort through all the rules and regulations – and help find ways to minimize the tax burden in the short-term and long-term. Since 1984, Reliance has helped hundreds of Tampa Bay area businesses find and stay on the path to profitability. One way to do that is through smart tax planning and a thorough knowledge of how best to navigate Florida’s tax laws for companies. Among the taxes a Florida business can expect to pay are:

items.text: Many others, depending on the type of business – including taxes on communications, documents, fuel, gross receipts, insurance premiums, pollutants, severance, and solid waste
